meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Team-first maximum-saturation research orchestration for omo-senpi. Scopes the topic solo, organizes the axes into a brief, then DEFAULTS to a cooperating team (team_create) - one member per axis plus skeptic/red-team members for ultradebate/hyperdebate cross-critique - with curated explore/librarian/oracle task lanes for recon, expansion, and verification; a recursive EXPAND loop until leads run dry; contested claims proven by executed code or locked through the claim-graph gate; cited synthesis and optional MD/HTML/PDF/PPTX reports. ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user demand for research: the word 'ulw-research' ('/ulw-research', '$ulw-research'), any 'ulw' research wording, 'ultradebate' or 'hyperdebate' research requests, or an explicit request for research / deep research / an ultra-precise investigation, in any language. Never self-activates for ordinary questions, debugging, or implementation context-gathering. While active it overrides exploration-bounding defaults: exhaustive coverage is the goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动组织多角色团队完成深度研究并生成报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速组织一场跨视角的深度研究并自动产出带引用的综合报告
copy.tagline_en: Orchestrate multi-agent research teams for deep investigation and report generation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly orchestrate a cross-perspective deep research with team debate and auto-generated reports

howto.what: 装上后，当用户要求研究时，Claude会先独立分析主题并编写简报，然后组建一个团队（含多个研究员和质疑者），分配探索、扩展和验证任务，循环扩展直到线索穷尽，对有争议的声明通过执行代码或图谱锁定来验证，最后输出带引用的综合报告（可选HTML/PDF等格式）。
howto.when: 当你明确要求研究时触发，包括说出“ulw-research”等关键词或要求“深度研究”。不会对普通问题自动激活。
